title: How to Buy with Confidence
description: How to Buy with Confidence and Transition with Ease Whether you’re buying to expand your current firm or looking to go out on your own, purchasing a public accounting firm or tax practice requires a plan tailored to you. Having the right strategy from the beginning can mitigate some of the risks associated with a purchase and will put you on the path to buy with confidence and transition with ease. Phase 1: Locating a Firm to Purchase Analyze your strengths and begin your search. Consider your current experience and educational background, determine the ideal firm size, client mix and service offerings that suit you best. Know what you’re looking for. Assemble a team of professional advisors to assist you with the process, including an experienced broker; a seasoned, competent business attorney; and an industry specific lender with years of experience financing firms and tax practices. Start the lending process by initiating the pre-approval process with multiple lenders, understanding capital requirements, and the process needed to complete the loan. Identify an acquisition by seeking out multiple firm offerings and targeting the right cultural and professional fit. This will include meeting with prospective sellers to narrow your search. Phase 2: Negotiations and Due Diligence Negotiate to acquire your selected firm. Bring an offer of terms that is fair to all parties, addressing not only the asking price but all terms involved including any employment contract for the seller. Transparency and flexibility will yield better results for everyone. Perform due diligence . After executing an offer or LOI, conducting your due diligence may include a thorough review of tax returns, financials, client demographic information, and operations of the firm. A CBI is an experienced, proven professional whose claim of competence is supported and documented . Our listings receive national exposure and our proven processes throughout the course of the sale have helped hundreds of firm owners achieve the “win-win” deal they were looking for. We work alongside our sellers throughout the entire process. Working together we get deals done. The company operates as a behind-the-scenes supplier to large, national distributors rather than selling directly to contractors or end users. Its core product line is incorporated into downstream construction systems, creating repeat demand driven by standardized specifications and long-standing customer relationships. Operations emphasize consistent production, predictable inventory turns, and disciplined execution. The business holds a strong position in a niche segment of the lumber market, with a focused product mix built around durable, performance-driven wood products favored by distributors and end users alike. Over time, management intentionally refined its offerings toward higher-quality inputs aligned with customer preference, supporting pricing discipline and stable margins. Customers include multi-location distributors with regional and national footprints across the western United States. Operations are run from a single, efficient manufacturing facility in the greater Sacramento area. Inventory typically turns in under two weeks, limiting working capital requirements and supporting reliable lead times. Production is scheduled against known demand, and the company ships approximately 150 truckloads annually using third-party carriers. The business is currently operating below capacity, providing a clear path for incremental growth through modest capital investment or expanded throughput. title: Northern California Charter School Membership Business
description: Northern California Charter School Membership Business Back to Listings Listing Price: $1,295,000 Listing Status: Under Contract Internal ID: 6396 For more information on this listing, please complete our Non-Disclosure Agreement Please Fill Out Our NDA Description This Northern California business represents a membership-based business focused on supporting and advocating for flex-based personalized learning charter schools. The business serves over 100 member schools representing more than 100,000 students. Revenue is primarily generated through recurring membership dues, with additional income from partner sponsorships and annual conference events. The business focuses on how personalized learning models relate to student outcomes. Aggregated data across its member network indicates that longer student participation in these models is associated with measurable academic improvement, including progress toward closing achievement gaps and, in some cases, performance at or above state benchmarks. These results are observed in contrast to traditional classroom-based systems with standardized instructional structures. The business operates with an asset-light structure and relies on external partners for key functions such as advocacy, data analysis, and communications. Member schools participate in a collaborative network, sharing practices and performance insights. Membership retention has historically been strong. The business presents potential opportunities for growth, including expansion into additional states, increased advocacy efforts, expanded partnerships, and enhanced digital outreach. Within its current market, recent regulatory changes may support additional membership growth. The business serves over 100 member schools representing more than 100,000 students. Revenue is primarily generated through recurring membership dues, with additional income from partner sponsorships and annual conference events. The business focuses on how personalized learning models relate to student outcomes. Aggregated data across its member network indicates that longer student participation in these models is associated with measurable academic improvement, including progress toward closing achievement gaps and, in some cases, performance at or above state benchmarks. These results are observed in contrast to traditional classroom-based systems with standardized instructional structures. The business operates with an asset-light structure and relies on external partners for key functions such as advocacy, data analysis, and communications. Member schools participate in a collaborative network, sharing practices and performance insights. Membership retention has historically been strong. The business presents potential opportunities for growth, including expansion into additional states, increased advocacy efforts, expanded partnerships, and enhanced digital outreach. Within its current market, recent regulatory changes may support additional membership growth. title: Exit Advisors
description: Ryan Parshall Business Broker & Former Agency Owner Our Founder, Ryan Parshall grew up in a small town, Odessa, Missouri where he was raised by two determined parents that came from no money. They earned every penny and fought their way into middle-income. His dad, Joe Parshall, borrowed money on a handshake to buy a local grocery store. It’s there that Ryan learned what hard work was all about. ​ His father taught him that good character, honesty, kindness and a servant attitude were the recipes for success. Graduating from Missouri State University in Springfield, Missouri with a BFA in Design, he took his first job in 1993 as an Art Director. He held many key roles that gained him the knowledge and expertise to become a marketing and sales professional. ​ In 2007, Ryan founded Lure Creative, a digital marketing agency in the Kansas City area. At first serving local, well-known Kansas City brands, he grew into HVAC and other home service niches that exploded Lure Creative onto the national scene. ​ After a successful journey in growing a marketing agency, Ryan sold Lure Creative in 2018 and went on to help other business owners as a Growth Coach and Business Broker at Healthy Brands. In 2024, Ryan split the Business Broker part off into its own entity, Exit Mergers & Acquisitions to better serve his clients. ​ Over the years, nothing has changed in Ryan’s recipe for success. He still uses the same skills his father taught and offers friendly service on top of his knowledge of business growth, buying and selling. Ryan prides himself in working relentlessly to find the right buyer and then navigating both buyer and seller to a successful close. ​ Ryan is the author of How to Build a Growth Engine which outlines a step-by-step process for using branding to fuel all aspects of your sales, marketing and team. title: Selling A Small Business in 4 Months
description: Business , Selling a Business How To Sell Your Business Quickly Chinook Business Advisory May 15, 2026 Business , Selling a Business Selling A Small Business in 4 Months 6 Full Price Offers.  2 Weeks On-Market.  4 Months Start to Finish. This is how Chinook’s process created an efficient and successful sale for a small business owner. Our client approached us to help them sell their business with a common reason: “I’m done.” They had started the business in their 50s and had grown it successfully for over a decade. Now the business was at a size that the owner could no longer keep growing. It needed technological implementation — but the owner was admittedly not interested in doing that. The business was simple and in a great industry with growth “tailwinds.” The special sauce in this business? The owner’s care. Care for the clients, care for the staff, and care for doing business the right way. This is a typical feature of small businesses — but it can also be a big reason why they are so hard to sell. How do you sell a business that is so dependent on the owner? Find a buyer with the same values, passion, and vision — but with a little more time left in their career. This is what Chinook was hired to do. What It Takes to Attract Multiple Buyers There are a few key components to offering a business for sale that will attract multiple buyers bidding for the chance to buy: 1. A Fair Price Our client was reasonable when it came to price. When we shared our opinions on what the market would bear — and why — they trusted our experience. We listed the business at almost 4x EBITDA , and we were able to defend it: Service contracts Sticky customers Low overhead No CAPEX More demand than the owner could handle 2. title: Take the   First Step Toward  Selling Your Business
description: Frequently Asked Questions 1. What is a business valuation? A business valuation is a professional assessment of your company’s worth. Our business valuation experts use proven methods to calculate value based on financial performance, assets, market conditions, and growth potential. 2. Why do I need a business valuation? A valuation helps you make informed decisions whether you’re selling your business, planning an exit, raising capital, or exploring mergers and acquisitions. Without an accurate valuation, you risk under pricing your company or missing strategic opportunities. 3. How long does the valuation process take? Typically, the process takes 2–4 weeks, depending on the availability of financial and operational data. Our team of business valuation experts works efficiently to deliver accurate results within a reasonable timeframe. 4. What is needed from me for a business valuation? To provide an accurate and defensible business valuation, our business valuation experts require key information about your company, including: Financial statements, tax returns, and balance sheets Operational data, including employee and inventory details Contracts, intellectual property, or other significant assets Information about your growth plans, exit strategy, or sale objectives Providing complete and up-to-date information ensures our professional business valuation services deliver a report you can trust for selling, exit planning, or strategic decisions. 5. Can I use the valuation report for selling my business? Absolutely. Our business valuation reports are designed to be defensible and credible, helping you negotiate with buyers, investors, or lenders confidently. They are ideal for business valuation for selling a business and business valuation for exit planning. 6. What influences the accuracy of the valuation? Several factors affect the accuracy of a professional business valuation, including: Historical financial performance and cash flow trends Industry conditio

title: Preparing Your Business for Sale:  Maximize Value Before You Go to Market
description: Frequently Asked Questions How do I know if now is the right time to sell my business? The best time to sell is usually when your business is performing well, not when you're ready to retire or facing challenges. Strong financial performance, stable operations, and clear growth opportunities often lead to higher valuations. Even if you're planning to sell in two or three years, preparing early gives you more options and greater negotiating power. How much is my business worth? There isn't a universal formula. Buyers evaluate profitability, cash flow, industry conditions, customer concentration, management strength, recurring revenue, growth potential, and operational risks. A professional valuation provides a realistic understanding of what your business could be worth in today's market and what factors may increase its value before a sale. Why should I hire an M&A advisor instead of selling my business on my own? Selling a business involves far more than finding a buyer. An experienced M&A advisor helps position your business, identify qualified buyers, manage confidential marketing, coordinate due diligence, negotiate favourable terms, and keep the transaction moving toward a successful closing. Professional guidance often leads to stronger outcomes than handling the process independently. How long does it typically take to sell a business? Most lower middle-market transactions take between six and twelve months from preparation to closing. The timeline depends on your industry's buyer demand, the quality of your financial records, business complexity, financing, and the due diligence process. Will my employees, customers, or competitors know my business is for sale? Confidentiality is a critical part of every transaction. Buyer outreach is handled discreetly, and qualified buyers are required to sign confidentiality agreements before receiving sensitive business information. title: Book a Confidential Valuation Callwith the Horizon M&A Team
description: Frequently Asked Questions Everything You Want to Know Before Booking Is the 30-minute valuation call really free? Yes. The call is completely free with no obligation. We use it to understand your situation and goals. You use it to understand how we work and whether we are the right fit. There is no fee at any stage unless you formally engage us as your advisor, and that decision is always yours. Do I need a specific timeline to sell before booking? No. Many of our best client relationships start 2-3 years before the transaction. The earlier the conversation, the more value we can help you build before going to market. We regularly work with founders who are “thinking about it in the next few years” and help them understand what preparation looks like from where they are today. Is everything I share on the call confidential? Completely. Every conversation with the Horizon M&A Advisors team is treated with strict confidentiality. We do not share your business name, financial details, or any identifying information with buyers, competitors, or third parties - at any stage of our relationship. What information should I have ready before the call? Ideally, have your last 3 years of revenue and EBITDA available - even rough figures. If you do not have those handy, we can still have a productive conversation. We do not need a formal presentation or prepared materials. Just come ready to talk about your business honestly. What happens after the valuation call? Within 24 hours of the call, you will receive a follow-up email from our team summarizing what we discussed and any resources relevant to your situation. If there is a natural fit to work together, we will outline what that engagement looks like. We do not do high-pressure follow-ups.

description: Trusted M&A Advisors for M&A Success At Horizon M&A Advisors, we combine decades of expertise in entrepreneurship, corporate management, engineering, strategic planning, accounting, and finance to deliver exceptional results. Our unique blend of skills provides a 360-degree perspective on the M&A landscape, empowering our clients with innovative strategies and actionable insights. We pride ourselves on a hands-on, client-focused approach—customizing solutions to meet your unique goals. Whether you’re buying or selling a business, our dedicated team is committed to guiding you through every stage of the process with professionalism, transparency, and unwavering support. Experience the Horizon difference—where expertise meets excellence in mergers and acquisitions. Book  a Consultation Tailored Strategies for Successful Business Transactions At Horizon M&A Advisors, we specialize in creating personalized buying and selling strategies that align with your unique business goals. With over 30 years of proven expertise in buy-side and sell-side transactions, our team brings unparalleled experience across various industries and complex business scenarios. Whether you’re navigating an acquisition or preparing for a sale, we deliver customized solutions to maximize value and ensure a seamless process. Trusted M&A Advisors with Proven Reliability Horizon M&A Advisors is renowned for building dependable and trusted partnerships with business buyers, sellers, and referral agents. Our transparent communication and client-first approach ensure a smooth, collaborative mergers and acquisitions process tailored to your unique needs. Industry-Leading Expertise in Mergers and Acquisitions With over 30 years of experience, Horizon M&A Advisors is a recognized leader in M&A advisory services. description: 9. Legal & Closing As due diligence nears completion, the buyer’s attorney drafts the initial purchase agreement, which is finalized only at closing—unlike typical real estate deals. At Horizon M&A Advisors, we collaborate closely with you and your legal counsel to negotiate this comprehensive agreement, often including detailed schedules outlining sale components. Once all conditions are met and documents are signed, the buyer’s attorney closes the transaction, funds are transferred, and ownership officially passes to the buyer. Often, sellers remain temporarily to assist with management transition. title: Understanding Investment Levels
description: Understanding Investment Levels Businesses for sale span an enormous range of investment requirements, from modest service operations to multi-million-dollar enterprises. Understanding what's realistic given your capital position helps focus your search productively. At lower investment levels—typically under $150,000—buyers find service routes, small retail operations, home-based businesses, and some franchise opportunities. These businesses often require significant owner involvement but offer paths to business ownership with limited capital. Mid-range acquisitions—$150,000 to $500,000—open opportunities in established restaurants, professional practices, service companies with employees, and smaller manufacturing operations. Businesses in this range typically generate enough cash flow to support owner compensation, debt service, and reasonable returns. title: Know Your Business’s Market Value Before You Need to Sell
description: Financial Statements Financial statements, such as balance sheets, income statements (P&L), and free cash flow statements are crucial for any business valuation. These statements provide information about the company's revenues, expenses, assets, liabilities, and cash flow. Business Plan A business plan is essential for understanding the Company's strategy, market, customers, and growth potential. Historical Financial Data Historical financial data, including revenue, expenses, and profits, are necessary to determine the Company's past performance. Market Data Market data includes information about the industry and its competitors. It helps to determine the Company's market position and growth prospects. Management Information Information about the management team's experience, skills, and qualifications is crucial to assessing the Company's ability to execute its business plan. Intellectual Property Information about patents, trademarks, copyrights, and other intellectual property is necessary to determine the value of the Company's assets. Legal Documents Legal documents such as contracts, leases, and agreements are necessary for understanding the Company's legal obligations and potential liabilities. Customer Data Information about the Company's customer base, including customer demographics, buying patterns, and customer satisfaction, can help determine its potential for growth and future revenue streams. Non-Financial Factors Non-financial factors such as the Company's reputation, brand awareness, and customer loyalty are essential for assessing the Company's overall value.

title: What is a Confidential Information Memorandum (CIM)?
description: Frequently Asked Questions What is included in a CIM? A CIM typically includes an executive summary, detailed company history, description of products and services, market analysis, management team bios, operational overview, and three to five years of financial data, including Value Drivers and adjusted EBITDA calculations. How does a CIM tell my company's story? A CIM tells your story by framing historical data within a narrative of future potential. It explains not just what the company has done, but why it is positioned for Growth Opportunities and how a new owner can leverage its existing strengths to achieve Financial Synergies. Who receives the CIM? The CIM is sent to qualified strategic and financial buyers who have signed a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) and demonstrated the financial capacity to complete the acquisition. This often includes competitors, private equity firms , and family offices. Does every business sale need a CIM? While very small "main street" businesses might use simpler profiles, any mid-market transaction requires a CIM. It is the professional standard that buyers expect and is necessary to drive a competitive bidding process. Preparing Your Business for the Market A confidential information memorandum is more than a document; it is the culmination of your life’s work as a business owner. It is the tool that transforms your operational reality into an investment opportunity. Because the CIM is often the first "deep look" a buyer gets at your company, its quality directly correlates to the quality of the offers you will receive. If you are considering an exit, the first step is understanding what your business is worth today. Whether you need a Compass Exit Opinion ™ to gauge the market or a full exit planning strategy , professional guidance ensures your CIM reflects the true value you’ve built. title: Discover the Market Value of Your Business: The Compass Exit Opinion™ Strategic Roadmap

The Compass Exit Opinion™ provides a market-based opinion of value based on current capital market conditions and recent transactions for companies with $10M–$250M in revenue. Is now the right time to sell my business? The right time to sell depends on both market cycles and your personal readiness. We analyze industry-specific trends, M&A market activity and comparable transaction data points, and your company's internal value drivers to help you determine if you should " Grow or Go ." If the market is favorable but your business has "detractors," we may suggest waiting until improvements are made. How do you sell a complex business like mine? Selling a complex business requires an elite M&A deal team that understands how to communicate your unique value proposition. We use the QuietAuction™ process to target sophisticated buyers who value your specific assets, your brand, and the team you have built, ensuring a smooth transition that protects your legacy. How much do I keep after the deal closes? The amount you keep depends on the M&A deal structure and tax planning. We perform a Net After-Tax Proceeds Analysis to help you understand the impact of taxes, liabilities, and transaction terms on your final cash-at-close. I received an unsolicited offer. Should I take it? Remember, one buyer is no buyer. An unsolicited offer can be a useful data point, but accepting one without preparation often leaves significant value on the table. September 18, 2026 One of the most important decisions a business owner makes when preparing to sell is determining the right asking price. It is natural to want the highest possible value for a company built through years of hard work, sacrifice, and dedication. However, the market ultimately determines what a business is worth. Setting an asking price based on the company’s financial performance, strengths, and current market conditions is one of the best ways to attract qualified buyers. Some sellers take the approach of starting with a higher asking price and lowering it later if necessary. While this may seem like a reasonable strategy, it can create challenges. Buyers often use the asking price as their first indication of whether a business is a realistic opportunity. If the price does not align with the company’s earnings, assets, and market value, many qualified buyers may never take the time to explore further. September 18, 2026 One of the most important decisions a business owner makes when preparing to sell is determining the right asking price. It is natural to want the highest possible value for a company built through years of hard work, sacrifice, and dedication. However, the market ultimately determines what a business is worth. Setting an asking price based on the company’s financial performance, strengths, and current market conditions is one of the best ways to attract qualified buyers. September 11, 2026 Many business owners wonder whether their industry will determine how easy it is to sell their business. While certain industries may experience periods of higher demand than others, buyers rarely make decisions based on industry alone. More often, they focus on the quality of the business itself. A well-managed company with strong financial performance will generally attract more interest than a struggling business in a “hot” industry. Understanding what buyers value can help owners make improvements long before they decide to sell. Buyers Look Beyond the Industry Every buyer has unique goals. Some are looking to expand an existing business, while others want to become business owners for the first time. Investment groups may be searching for companies with strong cash flow, while strategic buyers may value opportunities to grow through acquisition. September 4, 2026 When business owners hear the term goodwill , they often assume it simply means having a good reputation. While reputation certainly plays a role, goodwill has a much broader meaning when it comes to valuing and selling a business. In simple terms, goodwill represents the value of a business that cannot be attributed to its tangible assets alone. Equipment, inventory, furniture, and real estate all have measurable value. Goodwill reflects the additional value a buyer is willing to pay because the business has developed advantages that are difficult to replicate. Those advantages are often what make an established business significantly more valuable than the sum of its physical assets. Where Goodwill Comes From Goodwill is created over time through the work of building a successful business. title: FHA Loan in Orange County – The Shortcut to Homeownership (Before It’s Too Late) | The DeBlis Group
description: FHA Loan in Orange County – The Shortcut to Homeownership (Before It’s Too Late) | The DeBlis Group Christian DeBlis Jan 8, 2025 4 min read FHA Loan in Orange County: Your Way In—Before the Market Moves Without You You’ve done everything right. You worked hard. You saved. You built your credit. And yet, owning a home in Orange County still feels out of reach. Prices climb. Competition gets fiercer. The market moves, and every month you’re stuck on the sidelines, watching as homes get snatched up by buyers who seem to have more—more cash, more connections, more of an inside track. Maybe you’ve told yourself, “Next year.” Maybe you think you need 20% down. Maybe you think your credit score isn’t good enough. Maybe you think waiting will help. It won’t. Here’s the truth: Most first-time buyers will wait too long. By the time they’re “ready,” the homes they could have afforded today will be out of reach. But the ones who win? They know something you don’t. They know about the FHA loan in Orange County. The FHA Loan in Orange County Is Your Shortcut—But Only If You Use It Right 3.5% down. That’s all you need. Not 20%. Not 10%. Three and a half percent. On a $700,000 home? That’s $24,500 down. On a $500,000 home? Just $17,500. That’s the difference between buying now and being locked out forever. And it’s not just about the down payment. Your credit score doesn’t have to be perfect. FHA loans allow scores as low as 580. Your debt won’t disqualify you. Car loans, student loans—FHA loans allow higher debt-to-income ratios. You don’t need endless savings. FHA lets you roll some closing costs into the loan. And here’s where it gets even better. An FHA loan in Orange County is assumable. That means if you buy now and lock in a low interest rate, you can sell later and pass that rate to the next buyer. In a rising-rate market? That’s gold. This isn’t just about owning a home today. It’s about controlling your future. What Happens If You Don’t Move Now? Let’s talk about waiting.

title: Get Your Value Builder Score
broker_name: joel f. duran, cm&aa, m&ami, cm&ap, cepa, cmsbb
description: Driver 1 Financial Performance The cleanliness, consistency, and growth of your top and bottom line. For buyers Predictable financials drive higher valuation multiples. For you today You know what your business makes and where the money goes. Driver 2 Growth Potential How much more revenue is realistically available with your current systems. For buyers A clear growth runway is worth more than a great current number. For you today You know where to invest next, not just where you have been. Driver 3 The Switzerland Structure Your independence from any one customer, employee, or supplier. For buyers Concentration caps offers. Independence raises them. For you today A single client loss does not threaten the business. Driver 4 The Valuation Teeter-Totter Whether the business generates more cash than it consumes. For buyers Cash-generative businesses earn a premium over cash-hungry ones. For you today You take real distributions instead of constantly feeding the business. Driver 5 Recurring Revenue The portion of revenue you can count on every month or every year. For buyers Recurring revenue earns its own multiple on top of one-time revenue. For you today Cash flow is predictable. Bad months do not sink the business. Driver 6 Monopoly of Control A defensible position in your market, something competitors cannot easily copy. For buyers A defensible niche commands premium pricing and protects future cash flow. For you today You are not constantly competing on price. Driver 7 Customer Satisfaction Whether customers come back, refer others, and tell you so. For buyers High loyalty signals durable revenue and lower risk. For you today Selling to existing customers costs a fraction of winning new ones. Driver 8 Hub and Spoke Whether the business can run when you are not in the room. For buyers A business that requires the owner is a job, not a company. Heavy discount. For you today You can take vacations and weekends without the place falling apart.

A Broker with a Focus on Selling As a broker that excels at selling businesses , Joel Duran understands the nuances of matching sellers with qualified buyers. Joel’s commitment to the sales process means he works exclusively with clients looking to sell, providing them with expert guidance and support. This ample space makes it suitable for hosting a variety of events, from intimate dinners to larger gatherings. The beautiful buildout features a large bar and an exceptional outdoor area, enhancing the dining experience with both indoor and outdoor seating options. Established Reputation and Longevity One of the most compelling reasons to consider this business is its long-standing presence in the industry. Established in 1979, this company has built a robust reputation over multiple decades. It has successfully navigated various economic cycles, maintaining and even growing its market share. This stability is a rare find among Louisiana businesses for sale , providing a strong foundation for future growth and profitability. Comprehensive Product Lines and Wide Territory Coverage This business isn’t just a typical distributor; it is both a stocking manufacturer’s representative and a master distributor of products. Over the years, the company has expanded its product lines significantly, catering to a diverse range of industrial needs. Moreover, it covers a broad territory, including Louisiana, southern Arkansas, Alabama, and the Florida panhandle. Such extensive coverage ensures a wide customer base and diverse revenue streams, making it a standout opportunity among any business for sale in Louisiana . Impressive Financial Performance Financially, the business is on solid ground. For the trailing twelve months ended June 30, 2026, it generated revenue of $3,376,836 and seller’s discretionary earnings of $353,019. Despite the challenges posed by the pandemic, the company has shown resilience and an ability to rebound quickly, achieving year-over-year growth. title: Car Wash, Storage Unit & Income Producing Retail - Commercial Package
description: Positioned just off a busy highway, this rare triple-income commercial opportunity combines convenience, character, and cash flow in one dynamic location. The property features a well-established car wash, a thriving antique mall with built-in vendor income, and a versatile storage/shop building—offering multiple revenue streams under one package. With strong visibility, steady traffic, and flexible space for expansion or repositioning, this property is ideal for investors or owner-operators seeking a diversified, income-producing asset with long-term upside. Asking price includes real estate of three buildings and associated businesses. Owner will not split business operations from real estate and would like to sell all together. Call 417.889.9400 today for a showing!

title: Automobile Restoration
description: A rare opportunity to acquire one of the Midwest’s most respected and nationally recognized classic automobile restoration companies. Established 28 years ago, this Missouri-based business has built an exceptional reputation for quality craftsmanship, attention to detail, and customer satisfaction. The company performs everything from routine maintenance and minor repairs to complete frame-off restoration for virtually any make, model, and year of vehicle. Its award-worthy work has been featured at some of the most prestigious automotive venues in the nation, including Barrett-Jackson, Mecum and SEMA.

title: Nationally Recognized Beauty and Health Franchise
description: Take advantage of this exceptional opportunity to acquire a Nationally Recognized Franchise celebrated by Entrepreneur Magazine. The location offers PRIME visibility, strong demographics and a built-in customer base. Consistent revenue performance and a loyal recurring clientele. This turnkey operation provides immediate cash flow and the backing of a proven national brand.

title: Service Center and Truck Repair Business
description: 2025 was a financial success and a great year for this business! This is a rare opportunity to acquire a well-established, highly respected commercial truck repair business located in Southern Missouri. In operation for 12 years, this business has built a solid reputation for quality service, reliability, and professionalism in a market with very little competition. The business operates out of a clean and efficiently organized facility featuring four oversized bays with 16-foot doors—capable of accommodating full-size tractor trailers. All equipment required to perform comprehensive truck repairs is included in the sale, along with a large, well-stocked inventory of essential parts and supplies. A team of five skilled technicians supports the operation, and the business is a preferred repair provider for multiple commercial fleet accounts. Mobile/remote service capabilities offer additional revenue and convenience for clients. This turnkey operation is ideal for an owner-operator or an industry buyer looking to expand. The current owner is pursuing other interests and is committed to a flexible and smooth transition for the new owner.

title: Beauty Salon and Tattoo Shop
description: This well-established beauty studio offers a comprehensive suite of high-demand services, including eyelash extensions, brow shaping, microblading, facials, tattoo removal, and permanent makeup. The studio is recognized for its clean, modern aesthetic and consistently high standards of service, resulting in an exceptional reputation and strong brand presence in the market. A key asset of this business is its large client database of over 7,000 active and past clients, providing immediate access to a large, loyal customer base and significant built-in opportunities for repeat business, reactivation campaigns, and service expansion. The studio benefits from steady recurring revenue, strong word-of-mouth referrals, and established operating systems. This is a rare opportunity for a beauty professional to acquire a profitable, turnkey studio with proven demand, recognizable branding, and substantial growth potential from an existing client base.

title: Auto Glass Business
description: This well-established auto glass repair and replacement business has built a trusted reputation across Southwest Missouri for quality, reliability, and personalized service. With a strong local brand and consistent repeat business, the company has operated success-fully for many years, serving retail customers, insurance claims, and a growing number of commercial and fleet accounts. The business offers mobile service capability, enabling flexible scheduling and efficient geographic coverage without the heavy overhead of multiple facilities. It is ideally positioned for continued growth through fleet and dealership partnerships, insurance referral programs, and expanded regional marketing.

title: Profitable Italian American Restaurant
description: PRICE REDUCTION. Owner wants to retire! This restaurant is growing. Revenue and profitability are increasing. The restaurant has been in its current location for over seven years and has been a trusted brand in the region for 13 years. With a loyal customer base, strong community ties, and a reputation for mouthwatering classics like hand-tossed pizzas, hearty pastas, and signature entrees, this turnkey operation is perfect for a new Owner or investor looking to step into a proven, profitable business. This opportunity is in SW Missouri. The owner wants the business to continue to prosper and will support the new owner through the transition process.

title: Coffee Business & Commercial Real Estate
description: Own an established drive-thru coffee business along with the commercial real estate. Operating since 2018, this turnkey opportunity includes the equipment, inventory, staff and property - giving a new owner the foundation to step in a continue serving the community. The experienced owner is committed to a smooth transition. Request an NDA to learn more about this business!

title: Retail Scooter Business
description: Family-owned retail scooter business in Southwest Missouri for sale. Serving the region for years, this business has built a strong reputation as a trusted transportation alternative - offering affordable and fuel-efficient scooters. The business is committed to customer satisfaction, setting itself apart with an in-house service center. Partnered with top suppliers, they have direct access to factory parts ensuring a quick turnaround and reliable maintenance for every customer. Take the keys to reliable and growing transportation in SW Missouri where great service and dependable products drive results.

title: Festus Jack's Restaurant & Historic Main Street Building
description: This restaurant is a destination for homemade comfort food, smoked barbeque, and genuine Ozark hospitality. With an established customer base, highly engaged Facebook following, fully equipped commercial kitchen, trained staff, and memorable dining atmosphere, a new owner can step into a true turnkey operation with significant room for growth. Current owners have only owned since end of 2024 and health concerns are forcing the sale.

title: Subway Sandwich Shop
description: This is a great opportunity to own an established Subway Sub Shop.  Located right on the cuff of Missouri State University. It has been in operation for 38 years!  Nothing like having a potential labor force of 23,000 students within a 2 mile radius!  All equipment is in excellent condition and is serviced regularly.  Current owners run the business in a passive manner and do no outside advertising. Call to discuss this must-see business that will not disappoint.  Seller will entertain all reasonable offers.

title: Auto Body Shop
description: Auto Body Shop located in St. Louis, Missouri. This business has been around for over 45 years, has solid long-term customers and is in a fantastic high traffic location. Very solid back log of business and known for their quality craftmanship with timely service. This business is being offered at basically asset value which makes it an opportunity that can't be missed. The owners are retiring and will agree to a smooth and easy transition. Contact me directly for more information.

title: The Review Shoppe
description: For more than 35 years, The Review Shoppe has been Springfield's premier destination for upscale designer consignment. Established in 1990, the boutique has built a loyal following through carefully curated women's apparel, handbags, shoes, jewelry and accessories. Known for authenticity, exceptional customer service and extensive network of consigners, the business has become one of Southwest Missouri's most recognized upscale resale boutiques.

title: The Laser Studio
description: Established Aesthetic & Wellness Studio with Strong 2026 Performance This is an opportunity to acquire an established Springfield aesthetics and wellness studio operating since 2018. The business offers a diverse mix of non-invasive aesthetic and wellness services, including laser hair removal, body sculpting, skin rejuvenation, skin tightening, teeth whitening and other wellness treatments. The Springfield location generated $183,024 in revenue and $49,241 in Seller's Discretionary Earnings (SDE) in 2025. Performance has strengthened in 2026, with approximately $126,571 in revenue and $55,478 in SDE through July 2026. The $100,000 asking price includes approximately $76,000 in seller-estimated equipment and assets, providing a well-equipped, turnkey opportunity for an owner-operator, industry professional or entrepreneur looking to enter or expand within the aesthetics and wellness industry. The business currently has a trained employee in place. Assets from the seller's Joplin location are also available separately for an additional $20,000. The Joplin offering is asset-only and is not included in the financials.

title: Plethora Businesses Advises Federal Government IT Contracting Firm on Successful Growth Capital Raise
description: Plethora Businesses Advises Federal Government IT Contracting Firm on Successful Growth Capital Raise ORANGE, Calif. – June 15, 2026 – Plethora Businesses, a leading middle-market M&A advisory and corporate finance firm, is pleased to announce that it has successfully assisted a federal government IT contracting firm in securing growth capital to support its expanding enterprise services platform. The client is a specialized provider of digital enterprise IT and cybersecurity solutions serving mission-critical federal agencies, including the U.S. House of Representatives, U.S. Senate, and the White House. The strategic funding will fuel continued innovation, team expansion, and enhanced service delivery across its growing portfolio of government contracts. Plethora’s expertise in corporate finance and growth strategies enabled the client to navigate the capital-raising process efficiently while preserving the founder’s vision and long-term objectives. “We are proud to partner with companies delivering essential technology solutions to our nation’s most critical institutions,” said Bret Schaffer, Senior Investment Banker of Plethora Businesses. “This successful funding underscores our commitment to helping exceptional founder-led businesses access the capital they need to scale responsibly while building long-term value. Our team worked closely with the client to structure a solution aligned with both immediate growth needs and sustainable expansion.” This transaction highlights Plethora Businesses’ expanding capabilities in corporate finance and capital advisory alongside its core sell-side M&A practice. The firm continues to support founder-owned companies in manufacturing, technology, B2B services, logistics, and engineering sectors with tailored strategies for growth, transitions, and exits. title: 1143 VERNON RD, HARRINGTON, DE, 19952
description:
BE YOUR OWN BOSS - Welcome to Chicky-Juana. If you have ever wanted to grow chickens and have a full 1/2 acre of programmable automatic greenhouse with rolling tables - STOP You are not HIGH and such a fantasy place exists.  
This beautiful 21.9 acre chicken farm has two 43' X 550' clear span houses with updated fan motors, feed lines, drink lines, tunnel doors, solid meatal sides, LED lights, exhaust fans, stir fans and even includes some farm equipment. Both greenhouse and chicken houses are fully functional. Flock reports are available upon request.  
The 2-story home has 4 bedrooms, with a first floor primary, 3 full baths, water purification, pellet stove, dual AC and they will even leave the above ground pool. The home has been beautifully maintained and is ready for it's new owners.  
There is even an additional 5 acres of tillable land and the pond is filled with fish. Hunting is abundant and deer are all around. You can be self sufficient. Several buildings can easily be outfitted for horses or live stock. This is a dream setting for the family that wants to live on the land.

title: 692 BAYVIEW ROAD, MIDDLETOWN, DE, 19709
description:
A lovely brick federal style home with some Georgian characteristics. This home is placed on the national historic register. The property itself is 14.6 acres improved by mature trees, magnificent boxwoods, and lots of privacy. The home and numerous outbuildings were originally built during the local peach era, making Monterey one of Middletown's peach plantation homes. The outbuildings have just as much history as the main house.  
Additionally featured are several barns, a second 3 bedroom home, 4 car garage, and a 3 hole privy which is also on the historic register along with the unique ice and smoke houses.  
This country estate home is a great opportunity to add your restoration touches and make this your farmette in which to raise your kids, horses, and animals. 
No homesale contingencies

title: 30402 JAY PATCH ROAD, SELBYVILLE, DE, 19975
description: Welcome to the only USDA certified organic farm in Sussex County!  This 5.69 acre farm has everything you need to start farming this Spring 2026 including relationships with 4 local Farmers Markets and local restaurants.  DBA as Herb Spice Everything Nice for the past 20 years, the name is a well-known business in the Sussex County produce community.  The farm includes 2 greenhouses, 5 high tunnels, a 36 x 48 pole barn with an attached front porch and an attached 8 x 12 Vegetable Cooler/Propagation with 230 and 110 volt electric.  The field areas are protected with a 7.5 ft deer fence.  Included equipment is a 2008 Cub Cadet Tractor with a front load bucket and only 975 hours of use.  Compatible with the tractor includes a 60 inch tiller, 6 ft rear mower and a 30 inch bed layer with drip irrigation attachment.  See the Addendum for the full list of included equipment.  A 2016 Transit 250 truck fitted with shelving for produce delivery is negotiable.

title: 13651 WILSON HILL ROAD, GEORGETOWN, DE, 19947
description:
Three-house poultry farm in a strong Sussex County location with frontage on both Route 18 and Wilson Hill Road. Currently growing for Perdue, this property offers a solid opportunity for a buyer seeking existing poultry income, cropland value, and upside through approved improvements.

The poultry houses include a 44' x 460' house built in 1964, a 40' x 440' house built in 1974, and a 40' x 400' house built in 1984. House #2 recently experienced a fire and will require all new equipment, though the structure itself was not damaged. A replacement equipment quote from Marydel Ag is available at approximately $198,000. The farm is equipped with Chore-Time Model 40 controllers, Cyclone feeders in House #1, Chore-Time feeders in House #3, new nipples in both active houses, 3-year-old box heaters, three wells, and a 105 kW John Deere generator with approximately 1,200 hours. Electric service is provided by Delaware Electric Co-op.

Seller has already completed Perdue’s recent requirement for seven box heaters per house and $40,000 in foundation repairs on Houses 1 and 3. In addition, the farm has been approved through Energize Delaware for new doors, metal, plywood, and insulation to create solid side walls, plus ceiling re-insulation. The total quote is approximately $170,000, with 80% covered by Energize Delaware and the balance eligible for 3% financing. Seller is moving forward with the improvements but may also transfer the benefit of the approval to Buyer.

Nearly all remaining land is cleared tillable cropland, and the property offers highly favorable soils for a potential residential septic system, subject to Buyer’s own due diligence.

No showings inside the chicken houses unless birds are out.
